entries.trap.TRAP_BGO_4MB_VS_8MB.title: 4 MiB vs 8 MiB BGO/NOR Geometry ({base_va} vs {alt_base_va})
entries.trap.TRAP_BGO_4MB_VS_8MB.false_premise: Assuming a single fixed BGO geometry (e.g., confusing the 4 MiB vs 8 MiB window, base {alt_base_va} vs {base_va}, or 64 KiB sector count vs {sector_count}) between Loader ver0.63 / stock PROG061 and real DMR-EH55 hardware.
entries.trap.TRAP_BGO_4MB_VS_8MB.physical_truth: Loader ver0.63 (/BOOT.BIN 4MB/TOP BOOT at {load_va}) and stock PROG061 (at {prog_va}) operate BGO across {alt_base_va}..{alt_end_va}. On real DMR-EH55 hardware (8 MiB IC5001 Spansion S29JL064H), the BGO FTL spans {sector_count} uniform 64 KiB sectors at {base_va}..{end_va} ({sa_range}, {bgo_kib} KiB: {p1_count} P1 + {p2_count} P2 + {spares_count} spares, max_pid={max_pid}) while {post_sa_range} reside at {post_base_va}..{post_end_va}.
entries.trap.TRAP_TOP_BOOT_NON_UNIFORM_SECTORS.t: Non-Uniform Boot Sectors on Spansion Flash ({chip_8mb} / {chip_4mb})
entries.trap.TRAP_TOP_BOOT_NON_UNIFORM_SECTORS.f: Assuming uniform 64 KiB sectors across the entire Spansion {chip_8mb} or {chip_4mb} Flash without accounting for 8 KiB boot banks.
entries.trap.TRAP_TOP_BOOT_NON_UNIFORM_SECTORS.p: {chip_8mb} (8 MiB, {sa_range_8mb}) has 8x8 KiB bottom-boot + 126x64 KiB + 8x8 KiB top-boot (IPL RO = {ipl_sa_range} = {ipl_kib} KiB; EEMUL = {eemul_sa_range} = {eemul_kib} KiB). {chip_4mb} Top Boot (4 MiB, {sa_range_4mb}) has 63x64 KiB + 8x8 KiB top-boot.

entries.trap.TRAP_ES35V_MAIN_XIP_VS_EH55_BGO.fal: Applying DMR-EH55 BGO offsets ({eh55_bgo_range}) onto ES-series boards (DMR-ES10/ES15/ES35V) or vice versa.
entries.trap.TRAP_ES35V_MAIN_XIP_VS_EH55_BGO.phy: On DMR-ES35V ({es35v_layout_id}), the range {es35v_xip_range} holds executable MAIN_XIP code, NOT BGO! ES35V BGO resides at {es35v_bgo_range}.
Treating 4 MiB SPARC/VxWorks Flash (DMR-EZ485V, Macronix MX29LV320 bottom-boot) as an {arch_name} EEMUL 0xF1 layout in the final 64 KiB.
DMR-EZ485V (4 MiB) runs {arch_name} (LSI ZEBRA64 SPARC/VxWorks) with CLsiPMABS vendor_nvram spanning {ez485v_nvram_range} (not EEMUL 0xF1).
entries.trap.TRAP_DIGADIAG_256K_RAW_VS_128K_EXTR: DIGADIAG.FRM Raw {raw_kib} KiB (ver0.61) vs EXTRHEAD {extrhead_kib} KiB (ver0.63)
Using the {extrhead_kib} KiB EXTRHEAD format on ver0.61/ver0.18 loaders or a raw {raw_kib} KiB payload on loader ver0.63.

Loader ver0.61 (EH55) and ver0.18 (ES35V) load raw DIGADIAG.FRM of exact {raw_bytes} B ({raw_size_hex}) at {raw_load_va} -> JMP {raw_entry_va} with PANA__SD.FRM sd48 (TOC {toc_raw_hex}). Loader ver0.63 (EH58) expects EXTRHEAD DIGADIAG.FRM of {extrhead_bytes} B ({extrhead_size_hex}) at {extrhead_load_va} + PANA__SD.FRM sd64 (TOC {toc_extrhead_hex}).
entries.trap.TRAP_EH58_P7501_5V8_HDMI.title: {connector_name} HDMI +{hdmi_rail_mv} mV Rail on EH58 vs {logic_mv} mV UART on EH55
entries.trap.TRAP_EH58_P7501_5V8_HDMI.false_prem: Connecting the {logic_mv} mV Pico probe to connector {connector_name} on other DIGA models like EH58/EH59/EH68 without checking board SSOT.
entries.trap.TRAP_EH58_P7501_5V8_HDMI.physical_t: On board {eh55_pcb} (DMR-EH55), {connector_name} is UART JIG 115200 8N1 (Pin 5 NSW5V always Hi-Z Input without pulls). On board {eh58_pcb} (DMR-EH58/EH59/EH68), {connector_name} is HDMI connector K1KA08A00427 carrying +{hdmi_rail_mv} mV AV.
entries.trap.TRAP_MN103S_SLEIGH_10_CLASSES.title: 10 Classes of {arch_name} SLEIGH/Decompiler Traps
entries.trap.TRAP_MN103S_SLEIGH_10_CLASSES.false: Blindly trusting Ghidra C pseudocode without checking raw {arch_name} disassembly for inverted operands, NOT/BTST bugs, or removed blocks.
entries.trap.TRAP_MN103S_SLEIGH_10_CLASSES.physi: Default {arch_name} SLEIGH exhibits 10 cataloged traps (e.g., inverted SUB Rm-Rn, NOT decoded as XOR, BTST -> mn_todo(), BCLR 0xff -> local=local, Removing unreachable block hiding 400GB check at {unreachable_va}). Always apply {sleigh_patch} and cross-check addresses in the forensic atlas.

entries.trap.TRAP_MAIN3060NP_4MB_BGO_ON_8MB_EH55: 4 MiB -> 8 MiB BGO Retarget Required for MAIN3060NP ({base_va}, {sector_count} Sectors)
Assuming a MAIN3060NP binary built for 4 MiB Top-Boot ({base_va}, {sector_count} sectors, P5=8, max_did={max_did}) can initialize BGO/NFD on an 8 MiB DMR-EH55 without struct expansion and relocation.

On SATA HDD boot via IDE2SAT2, stock MAIN3060NP aborts with '[nfrom] BGO driver init failed[1].'. Applying --main-bgo-retarget expands nfd_ctrl to {nfd_ctrl_range} (14 trampolines + inline S13A/S13B + {cave_bytes} B stub cave at {cave_va}..{cave_end_va} + 48 relative offsets + P5=4 + uncached crt0/sbrk + 0x2202). MAIN3410PQ had a misleading literal ({native_detect_va}={native_base_va}) but also requires retargeting.
entries.trap.TRAP_SATA_BRIDGE_2MS_POST_RESET_RAC: {wait_factory_ms} ms -> {wait_patched_ms} ms Post-RESET Race on SATA-PATA Bridges
Assuming the factory {wait_factory_ms} ms post-RESET delay in PROG061 ({prog_reset_va}) and MAIN ({main3060_reset_va} / {main3410_reset_va}) suffices for SATA-PATA bridges behind DAVIS CH1.

StarTech IDE2SAT2 bridges (Marvell 88SA8052) need ~32 ms for BSY and ~555 ms for DRDY after RESET-; stock {wait_factory_ms} ms waiting fails at HDD_MAX_LBA {err_lba_a} / {err_lba_b}. Apply --sata-bridge-reset-fix (MOV 100, D0 -> {wait_patched_ms} ms via rtsd_sleep_10ms in PROG061={prog_sleep_va}, MAIN3060NP={main3060_sleep_va}, MAIN3410PQ={main3410_sleep_va}) + MASTER jumper + Type-B FFC cable.
BGO 'fvu.exe' Marker & Nor-FROM Escape Hatches in Loader ver0.61

Assuming flashing only {sa_range} ({nor_fvu_range}, {fvu_kib} KiB) makes Loader ver0.61 boot fvu.exe from NOR without the BGO 'fvu.exe' marker file, or that startup reason invalid deletes files beyond BGO temps.

In Loader ver0.61 ({loader_range}), {fn_check_va} checks for 'fvu.exe' ({marker_va}) via NFD inside BGO before copying {nor_fvu_base} to {sdram_fvu_va}; on repaired NOR {sa_range} is blank (0xFF) and SATA HDD autoboot requires escape hatches (UART 'F', FORCEFVU.TXT, PANA__SD.FRM on Nor-FROM boot).
entries.trap.TRAP_MAIN3410PQ_FALSE_POSITIVE_8413: False-Positive BGO Literal {false_literal} in MAIN3410PQ (Actual Table {wrong_base_va})
Assuming literal {false_literal} at {false_site_va} in MAIN3410PQ indicates a native 8 MiB BGO/NFROM driver needing no retarget.

On real COM10 execution, un-retargeted MAIN3410PQ failed with '[nfrom] BGO driver init failed[1].'. The actual .rodata BGO table at {rodata_range} ({rodata_base_site} = {wrong_base_va}, P1=3, P2=28, max_did={max_did}) is 4 MiB Top-Boot isomorphic to MAIN3060NP and requires 4 MiB -> 8 MiB retargeting for Spansion S29JL064H.
Proof against real EH55 NOR in {guard_paths}.
entries.trap.TRAP_4MB_BGO_PARTIAL_MOUNT_WHEN_F10: Partial 4 MiB BGO Mount When P1 Resides in {wrong_base_va} Window
Assuming a MAIN binary compiled for 4 MiB Top-Boot ({wrong_base_va}) never writes to BGO if BGO_Init() fails, or fails cleanly without leaving duplicate sectors.

When 8 MiB Loader ver0.61 moves P1 (0xF101) inside {window_range} (such as {p1_sector_va}), the 4 MiB MAIN finds 0xF101, partially mounts the FTL with 4 MiB indexing, erases a valid sector in that window ({evicted_sector}), and writes new pages to {split_sector} while {primary_sector} retains original LBN {lbn_hex} — producing dup_lbn=1.
CoW surgical reconstruction and tag contiguity in {guard_paths}.
